title: Highlight of our entire trip!
text: This was the highlight of our entire time in Spain! We had the best time seeing such different parts of the country. Ronda was something we had become familiar with through a desktop background (go figure) and we just knew we had to see it in real life! We traveled with my 2 year old son, husband and father. I was a bit worried how my son would do but he was so tired from exploring that he fell asleep during most of the travel time. Luis was an excellent tour guide, too!!
author: Kayla_B

title: Once in a lifetime experience
text: This was a phenomenal tour, the guide was great and the towns we visited were magnificent. It would’ve been very difficult for us to handle the driving ourselves.
author: Courtney_R

title: Totally recommended
text: Javier has been an absolutely spectacular guide. Super fun, engaging, and he took great care of us. A true luxury for the senses

title: Day trip to Rondo
text:
It was a great day trip to Rondo and some white villages. 
Luis is a fantastic tour guide. He is very knowledgeable and the rhythm of our day was perfect. He explained everything we needed to know and gave us options to explore each destination.
author: Jeannette_T

title: Rhonda and the White Villages
text:
Our guide was informative and very friendly. We were not rushed, and the transportation was very comfortable. Overall, an excellent experience  
The white villages were beautiful. The views amazing. with the added extra of going to Ronda
author: Sherpa683026

title: Great Way to see La Ronda
text: This makes for a very long day, but it is an excellent way to see La Ronda without renting a car. The city is charming. The white villages are nice and the last stop at Setenil was cool. We had plenty of time at each stop. Luiz was a great guide. His English was easily understood.
author: stacie369

title: An unforgettable day with an amazing guide!
text:
We had a wonderful experience on our day trip to the White Villages and Ronda, thanks to our fantastic guide, Luis!

Luis was incredibly friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. He explained everything clearly and enthusiastically, sharing his extensive knowledge not only about the places we visited but also about the interesting sights and surroundings we passed along the way.

He was also an excellent driver, always calm, careful, and in complete control, making us feel safe and comfortable throughout the journey.

title: A great day trip
text:
